text_block_list.name: The Six
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the foooood!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I forgot to get some water.
King, pretty please~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Do it yourself! Good grief...
At least pull yourself together on the last night of the training camp.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That's riiiight!
Let's spark up and overflow with motivation!
Tonight is a send-off party for all of us, yaaay!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. El will return overseas once again,
while we vie for the crown at home.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, autumn is starting again.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—It's somehow so strange.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Around the time I ate with everyone last summer, I had lost all my confidence and everything...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (And yet, once I learned where that "absolute" truly lay...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, I am walking a future of "possibilities"...
connected from that "absolute.")

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (To be able to stand on the stage of the 'Kikuka Sho'—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I was even able to run in the Tenno Sho (Spring), and...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I was able to deliver results in the Takarazuka Kinen too, and...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...I might even end up surrounded by reporters or something.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(There are so many "possibilities"...
...that I couldn't even imagine a year ago.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ? What's wrong, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: There's something I want to talk about. Once you're done eating, come straight to my room.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I went back to Hokkaido before summer,
...there was something Mom told me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...? Yeah, sure!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Oh reallyyy?

text_block_list.name: The Six
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal--!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Something Spe-chan wants to talk about...?
I wonder what it is, maybe about our next race...?)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Umm. Spe-chan, you there...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'm here.
Here, this is for you, Tsuru-chan."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...A pillow?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Throw it with everything you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Why?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I went back to Hokkaido, Mom told me!
She said, "Spe, go have a good brawl with your rivals!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Tell them everything honestly! And make sure to—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I told you, go apologize.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Apologize...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-CLATTER!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What is this, what is this?!
A pillow-throwing fight without El?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, El-san!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Why not? At times like this, you have to join in! Here you go, King.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...If Grass-chan has any thoughts on the matter as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, you're being noisy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fugyaa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah~~! *flail flail flail*)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, everyone!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Tsuru-chan too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat...!? ......Gaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...Yaaaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (POOF!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come at me, Grass!
The "Phantasm Bird" shall pierce the heart of the "Monster"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san, don't run away!
You're always so aloof... and so strong...
What is with you?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That goes for King too!
She's a sore loser... and she's got talent deep down!
What's all this nonsense about an 'unorthodox path'?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will mow them all down... However long it takes,
the one standing at the summit will be me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—I was so surprised when
I ran in the Tenno Sho (Spring) with Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"She was so strong! I thought I might lose!
And that—that didn't make me happy at all!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I felt terrified, and so frustrated! I was trembling with the thought that 'I was supposed to win, without question!'

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious I'd think that?!
With that kind of ability and talent, I mean!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan and the others were cool classmates who ran ahead of me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: They were another person I truly looked up to and respected!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then I wanted to stay the kind of person you could respect just the way I was!
I wanted to be the friend who could help you when you were in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But right now I can't be like that! I just can't!
It's so frustrating! I don't want you to surpass me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're the one person I refuse to lose to!
I just want to get ahead of you so badly!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Think whatever you want! But listen—!!

text_block_list.name: Spe & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm stronger than you!
Because I'm stronger than YOU!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaah... haaah...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're friends, classmates, and rivals.
...I'm being so terribly condescending.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I don't really mind.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to be completely honest,
I'm a pretty terrifying opponent for Spe-chan right now, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...When I'm running,
to the point where I almost hate it a little.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Because she's just that strong.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! He... hehehe.
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hey. Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: We're…… rivals, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The end of summer.
The cicadas buzz lingeringly as if reluctant to say goodbye.
Today's bus will take us away from the training camp, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
It's almost autumn. The autumn of our deciding battles.
choice_data_list: Yeah, how was it? This summer, I mean.
Yeah, how was it? This summer, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm fully satisfied. You gave me rigorous training.
I'm looking forward to the next season!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My "potential" is still expanding.
You might just get to see an unbelievable future.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm the rival of those five, after all...
I'm going to become an unquestionably strong Umamusume!
